project_type: Full-stack: Node.js/Express backend + Next.js 15 (App Router) React frontend
build_system: Server: plain node/npm, no build step. Client: Next.js (next dev / next build). npm workspaces NOT used — two separate package.json files.
test_framework: No test framework is configured (package.json scripts.test: echo error). Verification is manual: start server (cd server && node index.js), start client (cd client && npm run dev), open http://localhost:3000.
build_command: Server: cd c:\Users\Aditi\codemind_mega\server && node index.js | Client: cd c:\Users\Aditi\codemind_mega\client && npx next build
test_command: No automated tests. Verify with: 1) node index.js starts without errors, 2) npx next build completes without TypeScript errors.
verification_instructions: 1. cd server && node index.js — server must start on port 4000 with no crash. 2. cd client && npx next build — must produce zero TS errors. 3. Optionally: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:4000/api/flowchart/analyze -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"code":"if(x>0){console.log(x);}else{console.log(0);}","language":"javascript"}' and confirm nodes.length <= 6 (compact graph).
snapshot_or_generated_files: client/.next — generated by next build, never edit manually.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. Server runs on port 4000. Client runs on port 3000. CORS is set to FRONTEND_URL (default http://localhost:3000). Do not change port configuration.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found. Keep changes minimal — do not refactor working code. Preserve all existing exports/function signatures; only add new parameters with defaults.
key_patterns: Server: CommonJS require/module.exports throughout. No TypeScript. Each route file returns {success:true, nodes, edges, metadata}. Nodes are normalized to UPPERCASE types in flowchart.js route before returning. Client: TypeScript strict mode, named exports, hooks-based React components. All API calls go through client/services/flowchartApi.ts. FlowchartPanel.tsx manages all flowchart state and data fetching. Types defined in client/types/flowchart.ts. Tailwind CSS for styling (dark GitHub-style theme: #0d1117 bg, #58a6ff accent).
directory_structure: codemind_mega/server/ — Express API, no build step. server/analyzer/ — core pipeline: parserManager.js dispatches to ast/*Adapter.js, produces IR; flow/flowGenerator.js consumes IR and produces {nodes,edges}; routes/flowchart.js is the HTTP entry. codemind_mega/client/ — Next.js app. client/app/repo/[owner]/[repo]/page.tsx is the main IDE page. client/components/flowchart/ — all flowchart UI. client/services/flowchartApi.ts — HTTP layer. client/types/flowchart.ts — shared TS types.
